draft_evidence.quote: Cael entered the line, from the heel to the palm, and the fact that everything the man had went out along it and everything he paid came back along it, because there was a place ahead on a bearing where a thing with one line and one cost might matter, and he did not know yet how.

comparison_evidence.quote: Cael did not enter it as a weakness, because it was not one. It was a price, and a man who paid a price that visibly and wrapped it that fast had priced it a long time ago and decided. But he entered the line, from the heel to the palm, and the fact that everything the man had went out along it and everything he paid came back along it, because there was a place ahead on a bearing where a thing with one line and one cost might matter, and he did not know yet how, and had a page for that.
